Create ONE 2D fighting-game CHARACTER REFERENCE SHEET of Sable (the Veiled Blade), an ORIGINAL character for an original
indie fighting game. It must NOT resemble any existing anime, manga, game or film character.

The FIRST attached image is the approved HOUSE STYLE (another character of this game): copy its rendering exactly - the same
premium high-detail anime fighting-game sprite style, line work, cel shading, metal highlights, proportions, scale and the
same kind of sheet layout - but draw Sable, NOT the character shown there. The SECOND attached image is Sable's portrait:
match the face, hair, colours and costume from it.

THE CHARACTER:
A slender, lithe young woman with a light, coiled build and a low, ready stance. FACE: pale warm skin, sharp narrow dark eyes under straight black brows, and a black cloth veil over the nose and mouth to just below the eyes, its top edge lined with a thin gold stitch. HAIR: straight black hair, mostly hidden under the hood, with one loose strand at the temple. COSTUME: a deep indigo hood with a gold-embroidered rim, falling into an indigo cloak lining at the shoulders; a sleeveless near-black lacquered bodice with thin gold trim, black fingerless gauntlets with gold cuffs, black wrapped bracers, fitted indigo leggings, a gold-buckled belt, and black calf-high boots. A soft indigo scarf tail streams behind her. WEAPON: a pair of short, slim, lightly curved knives, each blade no longer than the hand from wrist to fingertip, narrow dark steel, black wrapped grips and a small gold crossguard. She holds one in each hand in forward grip: RIGHT hand on the right knife, LEFT on the left, blades angled out. Her energy and Flash Step after-images are CYAN light (#3ce0f5) with pale white cores, drawn as ghostly copies of her pose.

ART STYLE: Premium, high-detail anime 2D fighting-game sprite art: the look of a carefully hand-pixelled character sprite rendered at high resolution - crisp deliberate dark outlines (not thick black cartoon lines), cel shading with three to four tones per material, bright specular highlights on metal, a cool rim light, an expressive face with a clear eye, anatomically correct hands with readable fingers, convincing anime anatomy, fluid hair and cloth that follow the motion. Every figure faces RIGHT (three-quarter side view like the house style), the same scale (standing height about 240 px), feet on
the same ground line within each row.
